item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossy)】MP3 - Bridgit Mendler - Nemesis (OG 2016 Album Concept) [MP3 96-320kpbs, FLAC 16bit | 44.1kHz]
item.description:
Nemesis (OG)
Bridgit Mendler

Description
After the former Disney Channel superstar Bridgit Mendler cut her ties with Hollywood Records in early 2015, she started working on a new project which later became her 2016 EP, Nemesis. But Nemesis was originally supposed to be a full length album, even having it's own full tracklist including 10 tracks. But her record label (BlackBox) decided to cut the album into an EP and only kept the first 4 tracks, leaving the other 6 tracks in the vault.

Information
Recorded: Early 2015 - 2016
Formats: mp3/flac
Total Tracks: 12
Size: 183.5 MB

Tracklist
1. Atlantis (feat. Kaiydo)
2. Library
3. Do You Miss Me at All
4. Snap My Fingers
5. Oxygen
6. Flowers
7. Mercy
8. Loyalties
9. Long Run
10. Only Party (Snippet)

Bonus Tracks
11. Cold (Bonus Track)
12. Handshake (Bonus Track)

Notes
The opening track, Atlantis was originally solo but that version hasn't leaked yet

The bonus tracks, Cold & Handshake were not included on the original 10 track lengthed tracklist. But I included them since they are the only 2 outtakes from the Nemesis sessions to leak (besides the extra 6 tracks on the main tracklist ofc)
